# AI Box

> AI Box is a local AI server that stands on the customer's premises and runs its own AI, on a par with the leading
> cloud services. Documents and conversations never leave the building. Sold and installed by Jakup Güven AB, Malmö,
> Sweden, to businesses and public organisations.

Also described as: lokal AI, AI på egen server, on-premise AI, AI utan moln, GDPR-säker AI, AI för vården.

- AI Box S: 49,000 SEK ex VAT once (or lease: 1,950 SEK/month over 36 months, 2,600 over 24, 4,700 over 12; at the end renew, start a new lease or return the box). For one person or a small
  team taking turns. Writes ~53 Swedish words a second, reads ~600 words a second, first word in 0.39 s (best measured,
  one person).
- AI Box M: 89,000 SEK ex VAT once (or lease: 3,500 SEK/month over 36 months, 4,700 over 24, 8,500 over 12; same lease terms). Up to 8 people at once
  plus AI agents. Writes ~124 words a second, reads ~1,700 words a second, first word in 0.26 s (best measured, one person).
- Included: on-site installation and walkthrough anywhere in Sweden, updates for at least five years (the box keeps getting faster and better with them), three-year warranty, email support,
  delivery within two weeks, invoice payment.
- Data: processed and stored on the box; no cloud provider, no sub-processor and no account with the vendor. Devices connect
  peer to peer, encrypted end to end; when no direct path exists, through a relay that cannot read the content. The vendor reaches the box only when the
  customer turns on maintenance mode and accepts the session. With web search on, only the search terms leave the box.
  No processor agreement is needed for the AI; one is offered for support (on site or remote).
- Use: chat apps for iPhone and Android, the browser, Swedish speech to text, document upload, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.
- For: health care, law firms, accountants and any business with a duty of confidentiality or trade secrets. It does not
  replace a patient record system.
- Try a real box in the browser: https://ai-box.se/#prova
- Order (buy or lease, by email, confirmed before binding): https://ai-box.se/bestall/
- Speed replay (simulated, at measured rates): https://ai-box.se/hastighet/
- Contact: info@ai-box.se
- Not for: businesses that may put their data in a cloud service and use AI only now and then; the cloud is cheaper.
